$note: Knob contract for the Slicer reveal (SAISEI horizontal slice), recorded 1:1 from the RESTORED, owner-approved apps/quadro/public/slide-lab/slc-h2-split-reveal.html — the CONTAINED ~50vw calm version (NOT the broken full-screen variant). The two LOAD-BEARING fixes are encoded as constraints, not knobs: (1) NO RE-CLOSE — each beat owns one scrubbed ScrollTrigger over its tall band and the render STAYS open; there is intentionally NO re-cover tween (the recorded BUG-A fix). Do NOT add a re-close knob. (2) NO PLATE — renderBack IS the page cream and renders are eager-preloaded so the slice opens on a painted image (the recorded BUG-B fix). The SAISEI restraint rests on renderVw + creamAirRatio: the render stays CONTAINED (~50vw) and cream stays the dominant ground (>=55%). The slice is a CALM hard architectural cut (sliceEase expo.out, NO blur/gradient wipe), eased and scroll-scrubbed over a generous band, pixel-snapped full at sliceDur to kill the expo asymptote.

renderVw.meaning: SAISEI CONTAINED-render width: the render takes the 50fr lane of the sticky .beat-stage grid grid-template-columns var(--mx) | 50fr | clamp(40px,6vw,96px) | 42fr | var(--mx) (mirrored on .beat--right). The render is CONTAINED at ~50vw — NEVER full-bleed, NEVER full-screen. This explicit ~50vw containment is the recorded, owner-approved sizing (the restored calm version); the broken variant let the render go full-screen. Raising it past ~56fr eats the cream air and breaks the SAISEI restraint.

renderH.meaning: The CONTAINED render slab height (.render-col / .slab) inside the sticky .beat-stage. Capped at 720px so on tall screens it stays an editorial contained plate with cream air around it, not a full-height takeover.

creamAirRatio.unit: fraction of viewport that is cream ground
creamAirRatio.meaning: The SAISEI dominant-cream invariant: the two --mx margins + the clamp(40px,6vw,96px) centre axis + the 42fr text lane (minus its 36ch headline) keep cream the dominant surface (>=55% of every beat). This is a TARGET, not a CSS variable — it is satisfied by renderVw + the grid gutters. Drop below ~0.5 and the page stops reading as cream restraint.

sliceEase.meaning: The slice ease (E_SLICE) — the render decelerates into its final edge, calm and slow over a generous scroll band. A hard, anti-aliased ARCHITECTURAL cut: NO blur, NO gradient wipe. The expo.out asymptote is killed by a pixel-snap to inset(0 0 0 0) at sliceDur (no perpetual 99.5%-open).

sliceDur.meaning: How much of the beat's scrubbed timeline the slab clip-path takes to open from inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0 0% 0 0). The sticky .beat-stage maps the band's scrub-travel to ~one viewport (100vh), so the slice opens over ~0.55 viewport of REAL scroll — calm, slow, premium. At sliceDur the timeline SNAPS clip-path to exactly inset(0 0 0 0) to kill the expo tail. The light edge fades just before sliceDur; text resolves across 0.10..0.55; the climax inset opens at 0.62 (after the main is full).

parScale.meaning: Micro-parallax: the image behind the slice scales from parScale to 1.0 over the reveal (house ease air). The image is STATIC in world-space — this is a gentle settle, NEVER a squash. Hover lifts to 1.03 on a non-scroll surface.

scrub.meaning: ScrollTrigger scrub on EACH per-beat reveal timeline — SMOOTHING ONLY, not snap; calm and buttery. Reverse scroll re-runs the same eased slice backward (the natural scrub symmetry). There is NO re-cover/re-close tween (the recorded BUG-A no-reclose fix).

revealStart.meaning: The per-beat reveal window start: the slice begins when the beat's sticky .beat-stage locks at the top of the viewport (top top). The sticky stage then pins the contained render in view while the band scrolls the slice once.

revealEnd.meaning: The per-beat reveal window end: the scrubbed band runs through the full tall section (height:200vh) to bottom bottom. The slice itself is fully open by sliceDur (~0.55); after that the contained render is full and simply scrolls with the page — STATIC, never re-closing — as the next sticky stage scrolls in.

climaxPairing.default: last beat, inset opens at 0.62 of the beat timeline
climaxPairing.meaning: The SAISEI big+small two-scale pairing. The final beat (climax:true) holds its big render open; its SMALL inset detail (~27vw, 3:2) slices open L->R at 0.62 — AFTER the main slab is full at sliceDur (0.55) — so the two renders are NEVER mid-slice at the same instant (zero overlap holds even at the climax). The inset is pixel-snapped full at 0.84, then the main render breathes a hair to 1.012 at 0.88.

renderBack.meaning: THE NO-PLATE FIX (BUG-B). The slab/inset backing colour IS the page cream — NEVER a dark/beige plate. The closed slot reads as clean cream; the photo slices in onto cream. Combined with eager-preload (new Image, loading=eager) the slice always opens on a PAINTED image — no grey/beige placeholder rectangle ever shows. Do NOT change this to a dark plate.

alternateSide.default: left / right / left (.beat--right mirrors the grid)
alternateSide.meaning: Editorial alternation: beats swap render side (left / right / left) via .beat--right, so the eye travels — the SAISEI rhythm. Independent of the slice direction, which is always L->R.
